Body.Content:
Interactive Insights is an AI-powered feature in A365 Business Analytics that lets users ask natural-language questions to explore AI adoption, engagement and consumption data. It produces summaries, visualizations and reports that breakout patterns, highlight trends, explain usage and cost drivers, and support business decisions. Responses are grounded in available AI adoption, engagement, and consumption data within the user’s authorized scope.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
